$comment: Mission 1.67 §46. Pair readiness across the four existing candidate apparatuses and the two new serious candidates. Readiness is not selection (§48).

how_the_existing_four_would_be_viewed_un.$comment: §45. The registry gained a fifteenth rule this mission. This states how the contract now reads, and changes NO historical verdict. Old mission records stay exactly as written.
how_the_existing_four_would_be_viewed_un.onyphe: Its documented regional port-set difference is the case the new rule was written from, so under the current contract it would be asked the uniformity question explicitly rather than carrying it as a named risk. Its recorded verdict is unchanged and its package was not edited.
how_the_existing_four_would_be_viewed_un.netlas_leakix_shadowserver: No retrieved evidence of configuration heterogeneity exists for these three, and none was sought this mission. Absence of observation is not a finding of uniformity, so nothing is asserted about them.

measurement_construct_unchanged.$comment: §2 and §3. Frozen, and not narrowed to fit a candidate.
measurement_construct_unchanged.quantity: the number of distinct public IPv4 addresses from which, during a predefined observation window, TCP port 22 accepted a connection AND the peer sent an identification string beginning with the literal prefix SSH- before protocol negotiation

the_arc_position.target: two apparatuses whose independent measurements can reach one Claim, so the aggregator stops being algebraically identical to the B-2 pass-through baseline
the_arc_position.distance_from_it: two qualified apparatuses short of two
the_arc_position.what_this_mission_added: Two complete packages for apparatuses nobody in this arc had evaluated, failing at two different gates — and, for the first time, an apparatus whose TEMPORAL OBJECT is right. Project Sonar publishes dated, immutable, individually addressed per-study artifacts, which is what Missions 1.59, 1.62 and 1.66.2 all failed to find. It fails on the other half of the conjunction.
the_arc_position.the_shape_that_recurred: Both halves of the requirement have now been seen separately and never together: apparatuses with raw protocol capture publish a maintained current state, and the apparatus with immutable dated snapshots publishes no raw capture for this protocol.
the_arc_position.what_would_not_move_it: Re-running the same discovery search. §61 forbids it, and the two established blockers name two different dimensions.
